name: Surprise Spread
description: A layered seafood dip with shrimp, cocktail sauce, and cheese.
recipeIngredient: 3 (4 oz) cans small shrimp, rinsed and drained
Tortilla chips or assorted crackers for serving

recipeInstructions.text: Mix the cream cheese, sour cream, and mayonnaise together until smooth.
Spread this mixture in the bottom of a deep pie plate, pizza pan, or shallow baking dish.
Scatter the shrimp over the top.
Cover with the seafood cocktail sauce.
Add layers of mozzarella cheese, green pepper, and green onions.
Top with diced tomatoes if desired.
Chill until ready to serve with tortilla chips or crackers.

keywords: layered shrimp dip, seafood spread, party dip

_similar.name: Spinach Dip
_similar.description: A creamy spinach dip made with sour cream, mayonnaise, and Knorr vegetable soup mix, served in a hollowed-out pumpernickel bread loaf.
recipeIngredient: 1 pkg (300 g) frozen chopped spinach, thawed and drained
1 can (10 oz) water chestnuts, drained and chopped

recipeInstructions.text: Squeeze excess moisture from the thawed spinach.
In a bowl, combine the spinach, sour cream, mayonnaise, Knorr soup mix, water chestnuts, and green onions. Stir until well combined.
Cover and refrigerate for at least 2 hours to allow flavors to blend.
If using a bread loaf, scoop out a large hollow through the top and fill with the dip mixture. Serve with bread cubes cut from the centre and/or assorted fresh vegetables.

_similar.keywords: spinach dip, party appetizer, pumpernickel bread

_similar.name: Nacho Fiesta Dip
_similar.description: A layered dip featuring cottage cheese, cream cheese, and taco seasoning, topped with lettuce, tomatoes, and cheddar cheese.
recipeIngredient: Large bag tortilla chips for serving

recipeInstructions.text: Mix cottage cheese, cream cheese, and taco seasoning together in a blender until well combined.
Place the mixture in a large bowl lined with Saran Wrap and refrigerate covered for 1 hour.
Remove the dip from the bowl by tipping it onto a platter or large plate and peeling off the Saran Wrap.
Cover the dip with shredded lettuce, then diced tomatoes, and finally grated cheddar cheese.
Surround with tortilla chips and serve.

_similar.keywords: layered dip, nacho fiesta, taco seasoning, cheesy dip
